goal: Prevent orphan resolution requests from being dropped prematurely for non-segwit parent transactions
Avoid stuck orphan transactions when a reconsiderable non-witness parent arrives from another peer
agreement: Verified by testing on Windows with Clang 22 (Yudis-bit)
Suggested also caching txids for segwit parents to cover the mirror case (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes an edge-case stall in orphan resolution during opportunistic 1P1C package relay
Stops orphan children from remaining stuck when a reconsiderable non-witness parent is rejected
